name: SCO Dimension of Tagged Singletons
proof: For $n\geq5$, the established spherical dimension of tagged singletons is 1, so Theorem 12 gives $\mathrm{SCO}\geq2$.  Their established VC dimension is one, hence their sign rank is at most 3 by the VC-one sign-rank theorem.  The sign-rank SCO reduction gives $\mathrm{SCO}\leq3$.
